title: Route
summary: A RouteModule plus its registered path.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: A RouteModule plus its registered path. The generic preserves the exact module type for useLoaderData(route) and useFetcher(route). Do not annotate a concrete route with a broad Route type if you want inference retained.
sections.code:
const route = defineRoute("/tasks/:id", taskModule);
const data = useLoaderData(route);
